children: US community bank's Q3 net income fell 15.5% yr/yr due to higher credit loss provision
Basic EPS for Q3 declined 12.8% yr/yr
Company repurchased 29,282 shares as part of ongoing buyback in 2026
Company expects competition and rate environment to impact deposit levels and composition
CNB’s margin enters the final quarter with a strong tailwind due to asset repricing
Company will continue to monitor balance sheet amid evolving macroeconomic conditions
CREDIT LOSS PROVISION - Net income fell due to higher provision for credit losses, mainly from two large commercial real estate loans added to nonperforming credits
NET INTEREST INCOME - Net interest income rose 6.5% yr/yr, driven by higher rates and volume in commercial real estate credits
WEALTH MANAGEMENT FEES - Non-interest income increased, led by higher Wealth Management fees
